Getting There & Around

Logistics

Short flights, one hotel, and a driver who already knows the week

Flights
American Airlines
DFW ↔ MEX nonstop, about 2h40m. Mid-afternoon departure Wednesday; return Sunday late morning or early afternoon. Three to five daily AA departures give real scheduling flexibility.
Hotel
Four Seasons Mexico City
Paseo de la Reforma 500, Col. Juárez — on Reforma, steps from Chapultepec Park, walkable to Condesa, Roma and Polanco.
Ground
Private driver
Arranged through the Four Seasons concierge for the full stay — airport transfers, the Xochimilco run, and evenings out.
Weather
68–70°F / 48°F
Mid-October is past the wettest stretch of the rainy season — mostly dry days with a chance of a passing afternoon shower. Light layers, and a compact rain jacket.
Altitude
7,350 ft · 2,240 m
High enough to notice. Go easy on the first night's mezcal, drink more water than feels necessary, and treat Thursday's castle-plus-museum morning as the day's one real exertion.
Timing
Two weeks before Día de Muertos
Cempasúchil starts appearing in the markets around mid-October — Mercado Medellín on Saturday should be full of it — without any of the holiday's crowds.

The One Thing That Can't Slip

Pujol and Quintonil are the whole reason Friday is held open. Reported release windows vary between 30 and 90 days out, and neither is predictable. Create accounts on both platforms now, and check daily as the date approaches.

Everything else on this itinerary survives a missed booking. Friday night does not — so take the first slot either restaurant offers, and let the rest of the evening rearrange itself around it.
